name: Sovremennyj Sovjonok : Na grani mirov
source:
The events of this story occur after the ending of [url=/v53401]Sovremennyj Sovjonok : " Kto Ja ? "[/url], showing the result of Vasily's actions. 
Did he succeed in his plan? Or did something go wrong?
translation:
本作的故事发生在[url=/v53401]《现代小猫头鹰：“我是谁？”》[/url]的结局之后，展现了瓦西里一系列行动所带来的后果。
他的计划究竟成功了吗？还是中途出了什么差错？
